capabilities: schedule alarms with an optional date and label
run multiple countdown timers with pause, resume, restart, and cancel
alert with in-app popups, optional sound, and optional system notifications
control alarms and timers from a sidebar, status bar, and command palette
mark overdue items as Missed after a configurable grace period
extras: Desktop only by design; alerts work only while Obsidian is running and nothing rings when the app is fully closed. Not yet accepted into the community plugin directory; manual installation from GitHub releases is described.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in alarms or countdown timers, so users must leave the vault or use a separate app to time tasks.
summary: Alarm-clock plugin that schedules alarms and runs multiple countdown timers with in-app alerts, sounds, and system notifications.
